banners.prompt:
This input photo is a first-person point-of-view still from a vertical smartphone video: we see through the eyes of a man at his office desk, only his own hands and forearms. Create a NEW still frame for another scene of the SAME video (it will be the starting frame that an AI video model animates; keep the pose simple, hands already in their final position).

CONSISTENCY (critical): the SAME man's hands and forearms (same skin, same hairy forearms, same navy blue shirt with rolled-up sleeves, the same black smartwatch on the LEFT wrist), the SAME silver laptop, the SAME desk, desk lamp, paper coffee cup, printed sheets and black backpack, the SAME office. First-person POV, the camera is his eyes. No face, no head, no other people's faces anywhere.
PHOTO STYLE (critical): a real, unedited smartphone photo, natural light, natural colours, slight phone-camera noise, normal phone depth of field. NOT glossy, NOT cinematic, NOT stock, no HDR.
SCREEN RULE (critical): whenever the laptop screen is visible it is out of focus and soft, only the green-white glow of a spreadsheet grid, NO readable letters, numbers or formulas.
Only two hands with five fingers each. FRAMING: vertical 9:16. The image has plain bars along two edges purely as padding: fill the whole frame naturally, no bars, no borders.
Do not add any captions, labels, logos, watermarks or readable text anywhere, except the digits on the watch when asked and the book cover when a book is shown.
